verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the ACP path. Its delegated payment credential is a single-use Braintree token that is "bound to your merchant ID and includes amount and time restrictions that you can configure." That gives glancing per-transaction amount and time limits, but these are merchant-configured token constraints, not user-facing per-agent controls. Missing for 10: per-agent spend caps, usage or frequency limits across transactions, a user- or account-level control surface for agent authority, instant revocation of an agent's payment authority, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
